item.title: UK nuclear submarine deployed to Arabian Sea before Iran targets key US-UK base: reports
item.summary: Iranian FM Seyed Abbas Araghchi warned Britain against supporting U.S. military action, calling its decision to allow U.S. forces to use its bases "participation in aggression."

item.title: Iran chokes Strait of Hormuz with reported $2M tanker toll, regime threatens global oil supply
item.summary: Strait of Hormuz traffic is near collapse as Iran reportedly charges tankers $2 million in transit fees, prompting President Trump to threaten strikes on Iranian power infrastructure.

item.title: Influencers in Dubai claim it's 'safer here' than US, despite Iran attacks
item.summary: Dubai influencers say they feel safer than major U.S. cities amid Middle East conflict, as UAE intercepts hundreds of missiles targeting the destination.

item.title: Schumer knocks Trump on Iran, plan to send ICE to airports: 'Asking for trouble'
item.summary: Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer called President Donald Trump's plan to deploy ICE agents to U.S. airports "impulsive" on Sunday.

item.title: Cuban official reveals military 'preparing' for conflict after Trump considers 'taking' island
item.summary: Cuba's deputy foreign minister says the island is preparing for 'possible military aggression' amid Trump's remarks about 'taking' the nation in some form.

item.title: Carlos Fernández de Cossío: Cuba 'preparing' for 'possibility of military aggression'
item.summary: Cuba's deputy foreign minister says the military is preparing for possible U.S. aggression after Trump said it would be an "honor" to take Cuba.

item.title: Maple Leafs goalie Anthony Stolarz hospitalized after puck hits throat in freak warmup incident
item.summary: Anthony Stolarz was hospitalized after taking a puck to the throat during warmups before the Maple Leafs' loss to the Ottawa Senators. He was later released.

item.title: Waltz says Trump is using Iran's own oil strategy against itself to drive down global prices
item.summary: The U.S. lifts sanctions on 140 million barrels of Iranian oil at sea, while keeping bank sanctions in place to deny Tehran the revenue.

item.title: YouTube job scam text: How to spot it fast
item.summary: YouTube job scams sent via text are spreading globally, Google warns. Learn the key warning signs, including unrealistic pay and requests to move chats to Telegram or WhatsApp.

item.title: Mamdani's estate tax plan could drive wealth out of state, critics warn
item.summary: NYC Mayor Mamdani's estate tax plan would cut the exemption to $750K and raise rates to 50%, a move critics say could burden middle-class families.
